paragraphs.source_en:
(June–July) Moves to Bagni di Lucca (11 June). Translates Plato’s Symposium,
writes On Love and A Discourse on the manners of the Ancient Greeks relative
to the subject of Love (the latter not published in full until 1931).
 (first half of August) Finishes R&H.
(17 August) Travels to Venice with Claire to meet Byron.
 (late August–5 November) Stays at the Villa I Capuccini in Este, near Venice.
 Begins J&M and writes Lines Written among the Euganean Hills, October 1818.
 (31 August) Mary travels to Venice with William and Clara.
 (24 September) Clara Shelley dies, aged one.
 (October) Writes Act I of PU.
 (November) Travels to Rome, visiting Ferrara and Bologna en route (in Rome
20–27 November).
 (December) Goes on to Naples (1 December). Visits surrounding classical sites
and volcanic scenery, writes Stanzas written in dejection — December 1818,
near Naples.
 (27 December) Birth of Elena Adelaide Shelley.
